carmen.newhire: Hey team, I accepted the GitHub org invite but it attached to my personal GH account (I use the same name). I want a separate work account for company stuff. Can IT force a new account invite?
maria-peopleops: welcome Carmen! @it-support-bot can you advise? We prefer new accounts for folks who want separation.
it-support-bot: We can do the "require new account" invite flow which forces creation of an account for the work email. Quick Q: did you enable 2FA on the account you plan to create? Org requires 2FA.
carmen.newhire: Not yet on the work one. Also worried about losing my OSS contributions under my personal account.
devex-tom: You can keep your personal OSS account for public work. The new work account will be separate. If you want to transfer repos later, GitHub supports repo transfers but typically we keep personal projects on personal accounts.
it-support-bot: I'll reissue a new-account invite to carmen@redwood.ai and mark it SSO-required. That avoids merging with your personal account. If GitHub still detects a conflicting email, we can escalate to GitHub Support to disassociate. Sent at 2026-05-05T11:12:05Z.
alex-eng: FYI when you create the account: enable 2FA (authenticator app), add an SSH key, and then go to Settings > Organizations > click 'Connect to <IdP>' to authorize SSO. If VSCode still uses your personal GH token, run `gh auth login --web` and pick the new work account.
carmen.newhire: Got the invite, created the account, enabled 2FA, and accepted SSO. I can see teams now but can't push to a repo yet (403).
it-support-bot: 403 usually means you're not in a team with write access or token is stale. I see you're in frontend-team (read). I've added you to the frontend-devs (write) team and kicked a token refresh. Try `gh auth refresh -h github.com` then retry.
carmen.newhire: Refresh fixed it. Can push to my branch. Thanks so much! One last Q: my personal account still has my work email listed as secondary. Should I remove it?
maria-peopleops: If you want to keep accounts separate, remove the work email from your personal account to avoid accidental conflation. If you need help, IT can request GitHub Support to remove it from the personal account to be safe.
it-support-bot: If you prefer, we can file the GitHub Support ticket to unassociate the email from your personal account. Let us know.
carmen.newhire: I'll remove it myself now. Appreciate the quick help :tada:
